document_title: Haryana Real Estate Deal Review — Gurugram Project

rules.name: Project registration
rules.rule: Verify that the real estate project is registered with the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority where registration is required, and that a valid project registration number and registration period are available.

rules.name: Promoter and land title
rules.rule: Verify the promoter's identity and PAN, legal title or legally valid rights over the project land, current encumbrance status, and where the land is owned by another party, the owner's consent and applicable development, collaboration or joint-development agreement.
required_evidence: Development or collaboration agreement where applicable

rules.name: Approvals and sanctioned plan
rules.rule: Verify that applicable planning and building permissions, sanctioned plans, layout plans, licenses, NOCs and other approvals required for the project are available and consistent with the transaction.

rules.name: Project disclosure and carpet area
rules.rule: Verify that the project disclosures contain material information including apartment or plot details, carpet area, location, parking information, development details, project professionals and other information required to be disclosed to allottees.

rules.name: 70% separate account
rules.rule: Verify that 70% of amounts realised from allottees for the real estate project are deposited into a separate account maintained with a scheduled bank and are used for land and construction costs of that project as required by applicable RERA provisions.

rules.name: Controlled withdrawal
rules.rule: Verify that withdrawals from the separate project account are made in proportion to the percentage of project completion and are supported by the required engineer, architect and chartered accountant certifications.

rules.name: Annual project account audit
rules.rule: Verify that project accounts are audited by a chartered accountant within six months after the end of each financial year and that certified statements confirm appropriate utilisation of project collections and compliance with withdrawal requirements.

rules.name: Quarterly project updates
rules.rule: Verify that the promoter provides or files required project updates including bookings, parking bookings, construction progress, photographs and approval status within the applicable Haryana RERA reporting period.

rules.name: Agreement for sale and advance restriction
rules.rule: Verify that the agreement for sale follows the prescribed Haryana RERA form or Annexure A requirements where applicable. A promoter should not accept more than 10% of the cost of the apartment, plot or building as advance or application fee without first entering into and registering the required written agreement for sale.

rules.name: No conflicting encumbrance
rules.rule: Verify that the property being conveyed is free from undisclosed encumbrances, mortgages, charges and title defects. Where project finance or a lender charge exists, verify appropriate lender release or NOC arrangements for the property being transferred.
required_evidence: Lender NOC or release where applicable

rules.name: Interest rate
rules.rule: Where interest is payable by the promoter to the allottee or by the allottee to the promoter under applicable RERA provisions, verify that the applicable rate is the State Bank of India's highest Marginal Cost of Lending Rate plus two percent, or the applicable replacement benchmark if SBI MCLR is no longer in use.

rules.name: Refund timeline
rules.rule: Where a refund together with applicable interest and compensation becomes due from the promoter under the Act or applicable rules, verify that the amount is payable to the allottee within 90 days from the date it becomes due.

rules.name: Promoter delay and possession
rules.rule: Verify the contractual possession date and applicable delay provisions. Where the promoter fails to give possession in accordance with the agreement, verify that the agreement and applicable RERA provisions provide the allottee with the applicable refund, interest, compensation or continuing-delay interest remedies.

rules.name: Payment obligations
rules.rule: Verify that the agreement clearly states the total consideration, payment schedule, payment milestones and applicable charges, and that payments or loan disbursements are traceable to the agreed transaction and parties.

rules.name: Cost escalation evidence
rules.rule: Where an increased demand or additional development charge is imposed based on a government, planning authority or other competent authority requirement, verify that the agreement or demand identifies the applicable notification, order, rule, regulation or other supporting authority.

rules.name: Approved-plan conformity
rules.rule: Verify that development and construction conform to the sanctioned plans, layout plans and specifications approved by the competent authorities. Material additions or alterations must comply with applicable RERA consent requirements.

rules.name: Five-year defect liability
rules.rule: Verify that structural defects or defects in workmanship, quality or provision of services covered by the applicable RERA provisions and brought to the promoter's notice within five years from handing over possession are addressed by the promoter without further charge within the applicable statutory period.

rules.name: Association and handover
rules.rule: Verify that applicable requirements concerning formation or participation of the association of allottees, transfer of common areas and project handover or maintenance responsibilities are addressed in the agreement and project records.

rules.name: Written amendments and sanctioned-plan changes
rules.rule: Verify that amendments to the agreement are documented through written consent of the relevant parties and that additions or alterations to sanctioned plans, layouts or specifications comply with applicable RERA consent requirements and do not unlawfully reduce allottee rights.

rules.name: Registered real estate agent
rules.rule: If a real estate agent, broker or intermediary is involved in facilitating the transaction, verify that the agent is registered with the Haryana Real Estate Regulatory Authority and that valid registration details are available. The agent must comply with applicable RERA obligations and must not facilitate transactions in projects requiring registration where the required project registration is absent.
